cells.gaps: The 54,343 Congolese refugees of July 2026 are registered with a number, but no source says identity documents were issued to them. No source since October 2023 says refugees or displaced people may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID.
cells.note: Stage 2: ONPRA and UNHCR completed biometric registration of 54,343 refugees at Busuma in 2026, which shows registration under way. No source says documents were issued to them, so question 2 is unmet.
